title: Case 46: The Frankston and Tynong North Serial Killer

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一座葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干了。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐藏她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确定她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是档案文件呈现系列的全新节目，现已上线，您可以在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: Frankston is a bayside council of Melbourne, as well as a suburb itself, with around 135,000 people residing there.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克斯顿是墨尔本的一个海湾议会辖区，也是一个郊区，大约有13.5万居民居住在那里。

sentences.en: It sits 40 kilometres, or 25 miles, south-east from the centre of Melbourne, and includes a varied mix of affluent areas, as well as inexpensive and council housing.
sentences.zh: 它位于墨尔本市中心东南约40公里或25英里处，融合了富裕地区以及廉价和市政住房等多种区域。

sentences.en: It has a mixed reputation, with Frankston North renowned for drugs and crime, and the south more wealthy and scenic, with sweeping views of Port Phillip Bay,
sentences.zh: 它的名声毁誉参半，其中弗兰克斯顿北部以毒品和犯罪闻名，而南部则更加富裕且风景优美，可以俯瞰菲利普港湾的美景，

sentences.en: and huge houses nestled in the hills.
sentences.zh: 山峦间隐匿着巨大的房屋。

sentences.en: You have heard about Frankston before on this podcast, Case 23, the Frankston serial killer.
sentences.zh: 您以前在这个播客中听过关于弗兰克斯顿的故事，即第23案，弗兰克斯顿连环杀手。

sentences.en: But before Paul Denyer, there was another serial killer hunting in Frankston.
sentences.zh: 但在保罗·丹杰之前，弗兰克斯顿还有另一个连环杀手在寻找猎物。

sentences.en: Alison Rook was a 60-year-old widow who lived with her pet budgie in a red brick flat on Hannah Street, Frankston North.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森·鲁克是一名60岁的寡妇，她和宠物虎皮鹦鹉住在弗兰克斯顿北部汉娜街的一间红砖公寓里。

sentences.en: On Friday the 30th of May 1980, Alison was experiencing car trouble with her E.K.
sentences.zh: 1980年5月30日星期五，艾莉森的EK霍顿汽车

sentences.en: Holden.
sentences.zh: 出现了故障。

sentences.en: She ditched the car, and decided to catch a bus along the Frankston-Dandenong Road instead.
sentences.zh: 她抛弃了汽车，决定改乘沿着弗兰克斯顿-丹德农路的公共汽车。

sentences.en: Alison had to go grocery shopping, and visit the real estate agent to pay a bill.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森得去买杂货，还要去房地产经纪人那里付账单。

sentences.en: About 11am, she was seen by neighbours leaving her flat, walking towards the bus stop on Frankston-Dandenong Road.
sentences.zh: 大约上午11点，邻居们看到她离开公寓，走向弗兰克斯顿-丹德农路的公交车站。

sentences.en: Alison never placed her grocery order, and didn't make it to the real estate agent.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森没有去买杂货，也没有去房地产经纪人那里。

sentences.en: The bus driver working the route that day couldn't recall picking Alison up.
sentences.zh: 当天跑这条线路的公交车司机记不起接载过艾莉森。

sentences.en: Alison's daughter, Elaine White, made numerous calls to her mother throughout that afternoon and evening.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森的女儿伊莱恩·怀特那天下午和晚上多次给母亲打电话。

sentences.en: They had plans to go to a hotel that night to watch Elaine's husband play in a country and western beer.
sentences.zh: 他们计划当晚去一家酒店看伊莱恩的丈夫在乡村西部啤酒屋演出。

sentences.en: When Elaine failed to get in touch with her mother, she feared she may have collapsed alone in her flat.
sentences.zh: 当伊莱恩联系不上母亲时，她担心母亲可能独自晕倒在公寓里。

sentences.en: Elaine called her brother Keith, and together they went to check on their mother.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩给哥哥基思打了电话，两人一起去查看母亲的情况。

sentences.en: Keith climbed through a window, only to find the place completely undisturbed.
sentences.zh: 基思从窗户爬进去，却发现屋里完全没有被动过的痕迹。

sentences.en: An empty bottle of beer Elaine had drunk with her mum the day before was even still in the sink.
sentences.zh: 前一天伊莱恩和母亲喝过的一个空啤酒瓶甚至还在水槽里。

sentences.en: Police were called, and after an investigation, believed it likely that Alison was abducted while waiting for a bus.
sentences.zh: 警察被叫来，经过调查，认为艾莉森很有可能是在等车时被绑架的。

sentences.en: Despite being a major busy road, there were no witnesses.
sentences.zh: 尽管这是一条繁忙的主干道，但当时没有目击者。

sentences.en: No one saw Alison being dragged into a car, or speaking with a suspicious person.
sentences.zh: 没有人看到艾莉森被拖进车里，也没有人看到她与可疑人员交谈。

sentences.en: No one saw any suspicious vehicles.
sentences.zh: 没有人看到任何可疑车辆。

sentences.en: It's as if she disappeared.
sentences.zh: 就好像她凭空消失了一样。

sentences.en: On Saturday the 5th of July 1980, five weeks later, a man walking his dogs found Alison's body partially hidden by scrub on McClellan Drive in Frankston.
sentences.zh: 五周后的1980年7月5日星期六，一名遛狗的男子在弗兰克斯顿的麦克莱伦大道上发现了艾莉森的尸体，尸体部分被灌木丛掩盖。

sentences.en: McClellan Drive runs off Sky Road, which is where Paul Denyer would attack 17-year-old Natalie Russell 13 years later.
sentences.zh: 麦克莱伦大道从天空路延伸出去，13年后，保罗·丹杰就是在这里袭击了17岁的娜塔莉·拉塞尔。

sentences.en: Alison was found naked, her body decomposed.
sentences.zh: 人们发现艾莉森时她赤身裸体，尸体已经腐烂。

sentences.en: The discovery of Alison's body didn't help police further their investigation.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森尸体的发现并没有帮助警方进一步推进调查。

sentences.en: They struggled to find leads.
sentences.zh: 他们很难找到线索。

sentences.en: There was no forensic evidence left at the crime scene, and no witnesses.
sentences.zh: 犯罪现场没有留下法医证据，也没有目击者。

sentences.en: Their frustration was evident in this interview given to the Aged newspaper by head of the Frankston Criminal Investigation Branch, Inspector Murray Burgess,
sentences.zh: 弗兰克斯顿刑事调查分局局长默里·伯吉斯检查官在接受《时代报》采访时，

sentences.en: only days after Alison's body was found.
sentences.zh: 明显流露出了他们的沮丧，这就在艾莉森的尸体被发现后几天。

sentences.en: Alison had another son, Ivan Rook, who was a police officer in South Australia.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森还有另一个儿子伊万·鲁克，他是南澳大利亚的一名警察。

sentences.en: He said, When I heard the news that she was missing, I had the feeling that I wouldn't be seeing her again.
sentences.zh: 他说，当我听到她失踪的消息时，我有一种感觉，我再也见不到她了。

sentences.en: No one knows what it's like until they experience it.
sentences.zh: 没有人能体会到这种感受，除非他们亲身经历。

sentences.en: You read about a murder in the paper, and ten minutes later you forget it.
sentences.zh: 你在报纸上读到一桩谋杀案，十分钟后你就忘了。

sentences.en: I feel anger, and I wonder that anyone could be so sick.
sentences.zh: 我感到愤怒，我想怎么会有人如此病态。

sentences.en: A post-mortem failed to identify a cause of death due to the state of decomposition.
sentences.zh: 由于尸体腐烂，尸检未能确定死因。

sentences.en: Alison had two sets of keys to her flat.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森有两套公寓钥匙。

sentences.en: Neither set has been found.
sentences.zh: 这两套钥匙都没有找到。

sentences.en: The Victorian government announced a $50,000 reward for information leading to the conviction of the killer, or killers, of Alison Rook.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚州政府悬赏5万美元，征集有关破案或将艾莉森·鲁克的凶手绳之以法的线索。

sentences.en: But no arrests were made.
sentences.zh: 但无人被捕。

sentences.en: Joy Summers was a 55-year-old widow who lived only one kilometre away from Alison Rook's flat, although they didn't know each other.
sentences.zh: 乔·萨默斯是一位55岁的寡妇，她住在离艾莉森·鲁克公寓只有一公里的地方，尽管他们并不认识。

sentences.en: Joy lived on Norfolk Crescent, Frankston North.
sentences.zh: 乔住在弗兰克斯顿北部的诺福克新月街。

sentences.en: Joy suffered from arthritis and had previously had a stroke.
sentences.zh: 乔患有关节炎，以前曾中风过。

sentences.en: Every Friday, she went shopping with her friend, William Cotter.
sentences.zh: 每周五，她都和朋友威廉·科特一起去购物。

sentences.en: But on Friday the 9th of October 1981, William had a few medical appointments booked, so he couldn't go.
sentences.zh: 但1981年10月9日星期五，威廉预约了几个医疗检查，所以他去不了。

sentences.en: Joy didn't like shopping alone, but she decided to catch a bus from Frankston-Dandenong Road into Frankston to buy some meat on her own anyway.
sentences.zh: 乔不喜欢独自购物，但她还是决定从弗兰克斯顿-丹德农路乘车去弗兰克斯顿自己买点肉。

sentences.en: Joy was seen by neighbours outside her home at 1pm heading to the bus stop, which was only 100 metres away, at the intersection of Chilly Street and Frankston-Dandenong Road.
sentences.zh: 下午1点，邻居们看到乔离开家前往公交车站，车站只有100米远，位于奇利街和弗兰克斯顿-丹德农路的交汇处。

sentences.en: Joy was seen at the bus stop at 1.20pm, and was never seen again.
sentences.zh: 下午1点20分，有人看到乔在公交车站，之后就再也没人见过她。

sentences.en: The bus driver couldn't recall picking her up, and she never placed her order at the butcher's.
sentences.zh: 公交车司机记不起接载过她，她也从未在肉铺下过订单。

sentences.en: It had been almost a year and a half since Alison was killed.
sentences.zh: 自从艾莉森遇害以来，已经过去了一年半左右。

sentences.en: Like Alison, police believed Joy was abducted from a bus stop on Frankston-Dandenong Road.
sentences.zh: 和艾莉森一样，警方认为乔是在弗兰克斯顿-丹德农路的一个公交车站被绑架的。

sentences.en: Her friend William Cotter was convinced that Joy would not have accepted a lift from a stranger.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友威廉·科特确信，乔绝不会接受陌生人的搭车。

sentences.en: Yet, just like in Alison's case, no-one saw a struggle, or anything suspicious, along the busy road that day.
sentences.zh: 然而，就像艾莉森的案子一样，那天在这条繁忙的路上，没有人看到打斗或任何可疑情况。

sentences.en: It was six weeks later, Sunday the 22nd of November 1981, about 11am,
sentences.zh: 六周后的1981年11月22日星期日，大约上午11点，

sentences.en: a man collecting firewood found Joy's naked body hidden in thick scrub in bushland near the intersection of Sky Road and McClellan Drive, Frankston North.
sentences.zh: 一名收集柴火的男子在弗兰克斯顿北部天空路和麦克莱伦大道交汇处附近的灌木林中，发现了乔赤裸的尸体，尸体藏在厚厚的灌木丛中。

sentences.en: Only about three kilometres away from where Alison Rook's body was located.
sentences.zh: 距离发现艾莉森·鲁克尸体的地方只有大约三公里。

sentences.en: Like Alison's body, Joy was covered, but not buried.
sentences.zh: 和艾莉森的尸体一样，乔的尸体被遮盖着，但没有被埋葬。

sentences.en: A post-mortem also failed to find a cause of death in Joy's case, due to decomposition.
sentences.zh: 由于腐烂，乔的尸检同样未能查明死因。

sentences.en: Police determined that Alison and Joy's murders were linked.
sentences.zh: 警方确定艾莉森和乔的谋杀案是有联系的。

sentences.en: There were more than just a few similarities.
sentences.zh: 相似之处不仅仅只有几个。

sentences.en: The two murders were almost identical.
sentences.zh: 这两起谋杀案几乎一模一样。

sentences.en: Two special hotlines were set up at Frankston Police Station, with Inspector Walsh warning that they believed the Frankston killer would strike again.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克斯顿警察局设立了两条特别热线，沃尔什督察发出警告称，他们相信弗兰克斯顿杀手会再次作案。

sentences.en: The early working theory was that Joy and Alison had probably accepted lifts from the killer after mistaking him for someone they knew or trusted.
sentences.zh: 早期的初步理论是，乔和艾莉森可能是把凶手误认为是他们认识或信任的人，从而上了他的车。

sentences.en: They were then killed and their bodies dumped the same day.
sentences.zh: 然后她们在同一天被杀害并抛尸。

sentences.en: They even considered that the killer may have been in disguise.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至认为凶手可能进行了伪装。

sentences.en: Chief Inspector Burgess said, They weren't the type of women who would jump into a car with just anyone.
sentences.zh: 总督察伯吉斯说，她们不是那种会随便跟任何人上车的女性。

sentences.en: It would have to be someone they felt confident to get into a car with.
sentences.zh: 那一定是一个她们觉得可以放心上车的人。

sentences.en: It is quite feasible that the killer could be someone dressed up as a woman, a priest, or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 凶手很有可能是扮成女人、牧师或诸如此类的人。

sentences.en: He continued that he believed the killer was clever, not the kind to drop his wallet at the scene or leave any evidence behind.
sentences.zh: 他接着说，他认为凶手很聪明，不是那种会在现场掉落钱包或留下任何证据的人。

sentences.en: He concluded that the killer probably lived in the area and knew it well.
sentences.zh: 他得出结论，凶手可能住在附近并且对那里很熟悉。

sentences.en: Burgess appealed to the public, particularly middle-aged and elderly women who had been offered a lift at a bus stop
sentences.zh: 伯吉斯向公众呼吁，特别是那些在公交车站被人搭讪过的中年和老年女性，

sentences.en: to contact one of the special hotlines at Frankston Police Station.
sentences.zh: 请与弗兰克斯顿警察局的特别热线之一取得联系。

sentences.en: Burgess was convinced there were women out there who had refused lifts and then probably didn't think any more of it afterward.
sentences.zh: 伯吉斯坚信，有些女性曾经拒绝过搭车，之后可能根本没把这事放在心上。

sentences.en: This appeal did generate a lead for police, which we will get into later.
sentences.zh: 这一呼吁确实为警方提供了一条线索，我们稍后会详细探讨。

sentences.en: But first, a quote from Inspector Les Walsh from the Victorian Police Homicide Squad.
sentences.zh: 但首先，引用维多利亚州警察凶杀案调查组莱斯·沃尔什督察的一句话。

sentences.en: Tainong is obviously something we don't just push out of our minds and forget about.
sentences.zh: 泰农显然不是我们能轻易抛诸脑后并忘记的事情。

sentences.en: But at this stage, we are still treating Tainong as a different investigation.
sentences.zh: 但在现阶段，我们仍将泰农案视为一项不同的调查。

sentences.en: So what was the Tainong investigation?
sentences.zh: 那么什么是泰农调查呢？

sentences.en: In 1980, the same year Alison was murdered in Frankston,
sentences.zh: 1980年，也就是艾莉森在弗兰克斯顿遇害的同一年，

sentences.en: Bertha Miller was 75 years old and living with her brother-in-law,
sentences.zh: 伯莎·米勒75岁，和她的连襟

sentences.en: William Ross, on Cardenia Street, Gleniris.
sentences.zh: 威廉·罗斯一起住在格伦艾瑞斯的卡代尼亚街。

sentences.en: Gleniris is an affluent suburb in Melbourne's east, situated in what is now known as the Golden Triangle, about 45 kilometres north of Frankston.
sentences.zh: 格伦艾瑞斯是墨尔本东部的一个富裕郊区，位于现在被称为黄金三角地带的地方，在弗兰克斯顿以北约45公里处。

sentences.en: Bertha had lived there for more than 25 years.
sentences.zh: 伯莎在那里住了25年以上。

sentences.en: Bertha was an active and alert woman, in good health, with a large group of friends.
sentences.zh: 伯莎是一个活跃而敏锐的女性，身体健康，有着一大群朋友。

sentences.en: She was heavily involved in her local church.
sentences.zh: 她积极参与当地教会的活动。

sentences.en: Bertha had worked with the Spring Street Mission in the central Melbourne suburb, Paran, for over 40 years.
sentences.zh: 伯莎曾在墨尔本市中心帕兰郊区的斯普林街教会工作了40多年。

sentences.en: She was the longest-serving member, having joined in 1932.
sentences.zh: 她是服务时间最长的成员，于1932年加入。

sentences.en: She also worked at the Sunday School and was the church treasurer.
sentences.zh: 她还在主日学校工作，并担任教会财务主管。

sentences.en: The church priest described her as a humble woman who spent her life helping others.
sentences.zh: 教会牧师形容她是一个谦逊的女人，一生都在帮助别人。

sentences.en: Although not a wealthy woman, she sent money to many other Christian missions.
sentences.zh: 虽然她并不富裕，但她向许多其他基督教传教机构寄钱。

sentences.en: At 10.15am on Sunday the 10th of August, 1980,
sentences.zh: 1980年8月10日星期日上午10点15分，

sentences.en: Bertha called out to her brother-in-law, William, who was in the shower.
sentences.zh: 伯莎喊了正在洗澡的连襟威廉。

sentences.en: She told him she was off to church, she would be home late, and not to wait for her to have lunch.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他她要去教堂，会回家很晚，让他不要等她吃午饭。

sentences.en: In order to get to the church, Bertha caught the tram from High Street, Gleniris.
sentences.zh: 为了去教堂，伯莎从格伦艾瑞斯的高街乘有轨电车。

sentences.en: Her good friend, Jessie Moore, lived nearby in Burke Road.
sentences.zh: 她的好朋友杰西·穆尔住在伯克路附近。

sentences.en: For the previous 10 years, Bertha and Jessie caught the same tram to church every Sunday, the 10.47am along High Street.
sentences.zh: 在过去的10年里，伯莎和杰西每个星期日都乘坐同一班有轨电车去教堂，即沿高街行驶上午10点47分的电车。

sentences.en: Bertha boarded at the Terminus, and Jessie joined her shortly after at the Burke Road stop.
sentences.zh: 伯莎在终点站上车，杰西不久后在伯克路站加入她。

sentences.en: When Jessie got on the tram that day, Bertha was nowhere to be found.
sentences.zh: 当杰西那天上车时，到处都找不到伯莎。

sentences.en: Jessie thought that maybe Bertha had gotten an earlier tram, so she could deal with the church business.
sentences.zh: 杰西以为伯莎可能坐了早一点的电车，这样她就可以处理教会事务了。

sentences.en: Bertha was last seen by a shopkeeper making the 400-metre walk to the tram stop.
sentences.zh: 伯莎最后一次被看到是在走向电车车站的400米路上，当时有一名店主看到了她。

sentences.en: Police were called and conducted an investigation.
sentences.zh: 警察被叫来并展开了调查。

sentences.en: This one was close to home.
sentences.zh: 这个案子离他们很近。

sentences.en: Bertha Miller was the auntie of the then Victorian Police Commissioner, Mick Miller.
sentences.zh: 伯莎·米勒是时任维多利亚州警察局长米克·米勒的姑姑。

sentences.en: But there were no witnesses, no signs of a struggle, no leads at all.
sentences.zh: 但没有目击者，没有打斗迹象，完全没有任何线索。

sentences.en: No one had seen anything suspicious.
sentences.zh: 没有人看到任何可疑情况。

sentences.en: Bertha had disappeared without a trace.
sentences.zh: 伯莎消失得无影无踪。

sentences.en: Catherine Hedland was 14 years old.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳·赫德兰14岁。

sentences.en: She had moved to Australia from England with her family in 1966, when she was just one.
sentences.zh: 她在一岁时于1966年随家人从英国搬到澳大利亚。

sentences.en: They immigrated during the era of the 10-pound POM scheme, when British and Australian governments worked together to help populate Australia.
sentences.zh: 他们是在10英镑普姆计划时代移民的，当时英国和澳大利亚政府合作帮助填充澳大利亚人口。

sentences.en: The outer eastern suburbs of Melbourne were heavily populated with English immigrants during the time.
sentences.zh: 当时墨尔本的远东郊区居住着大量英国移民。

sentences.en: She lived with her mother and older brother in Allen Street, Berwick.
sentences.zh: 她和母亲以及哥哥住在贝里克艾伦街。

sentences.en: This outer southeastern suburb was at the time a rural area, only just starting to kick off with housing developments and subdivision.
sentences.zh: 这个东南远郊当时还是一个乡村地区，刚刚开始进行房屋开发和细分。

sentences.en: Berwick is a little further southeast of Glen Iris, and northeast of Frankston.
sentences.zh: 贝里克在格伦艾瑞斯东南偏远一点，在弗兰克斯顿东北方向。

sentences.en: Catherine was popular at school.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳在学校很受欢迎。

sentences.en: She loved competing with her horse, Prince, in local equestrian competitions.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢带着她的马王子参加当地的马术比赛。

sentences.en: It was her horse that led her to receive an ultimatum from her mother, Hazel.
sentences.zh: 正是她的马让她收到了母亲黑兹尔的最后通牒。

sentences.en: Either get a job to help with its upkeep, or we sell the horse.
sentences.zh: 要么找份工作来帮忙维持它的开销，要么我们卖掉这匹马。

sentences.en: Catherine chose the job.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳选择了工作。

sentences.en: Hazel worked at the Coles Supermarket in the local Fountain Gate Shopping Centre.
sentences.zh: 黑兹尔在当地喷泉门购物中心的科尔斯超市工作。

sentences.en: She got Catherine a job there working part-time on weekends.
sentences.zh: 她给凯瑟琳在那里找了一份周末兼职的工作。

sentences.en: And Thursday the 28th of August 1980, during the school holidays, was to be Catherine's first mid-week shift.
sentences.zh: 1980年8月28日星期四，正值学校假期，这将是凯瑟琳的第一个工作日中班。

sentences.en: It was two and a half weeks after Bertha had gone missing in Glen Iris.
sentences.zh: 这距离伯莎在格伦艾瑞斯失踪已经过去了两个半星期。

sentences.en: Hazel Hedland, Catherine's mum, left home that day at 8.30am, leaving Catherine 70 cents for the bus fare.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳的妈妈黑兹尔那天早上8点30分离开家，留给凯瑟琳70美分的公交车费。

sentences.en: Catherine didn't start work until 12 midday, but she left home at 9.30am to visit her boyfriend, John McManus.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳直到中午12点才上班，但她上午9点30分就离开家去拜访她的男朋友约翰·麦克马纳斯。

sentences.en: John lived on High Street, Berwick, about a one-mile walk.
sentences.zh: 约翰住在贝里克的高街，步行大约一英里。

sentences.en: John had a number of other friends visiting, and they watched TV and listened to records.
sentences.zh: 约翰家里还有其他几个朋友在拜访，他们一起看电视、听唱片。

sentences.en: Catherine told her friends she wasn't particularly keen on going to work, and that she wanted to quit altogether because it was stifling her social life.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳告诉朋友们她并不是很想去上班，她想彻底辞职，因为这扼杀了她的社交生活。

sentences.en: At 11.10am, Catherine left John's house and walked to the bus stop at the corner of Manuka Road and High Street, where she planned to catch the 11.20am bus to work.
sentences.zh: 上午11点10分，凯瑟琳离开约翰的家，走到曼uka路和高街交汇处的公交车站，她计划在那里搭乘11点20分的公交车去上班。

sentences.en: Catherine never made it to work.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳没有去上班。

sentences.en: She was never seen again.
sentences.zh: 她再也没有被看见过。

sentences.en: Police were called and immediately launched an investigation.
sentences.zh: 警察被叫来并立即展开调查。

sentences.en: Many people came forward with alleged sightings of Catherine later that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 当天下午，许多人前来提供据称看到凯瑟琳的目击情报。

sentences.en: This confused the initial investigation.
sentences.zh: 这扰乱了最初的调查。

sentences.en: A bus driver was adamant that he picked up a girl matching Catherine's description and a blonde girl about the same age at the Peel Street bus stop,
sentences.zh: 一名公交车司机坚称他在皮尔街公交车站接载过一个符合凯瑟琳特征的女孩和一个差不多大金发女孩，

sentences.en: which is about 800 metres away from the Manuka Road stop.
sentences.zh: 该车站距离曼uka路车站约800米。

sentences.en: Others claimed to have seen Catherine about 2.30pm that afternoon in Narry Warren, about 8km away from Catherine's bus stop, speaking with a blonde girl.
sentences.zh: 其他人声称当天下午2点30分左右在纳里沃伦看到了凯瑟琳，距离凯瑟琳的公交车站约8公里，当时她正和一个金发女孩交谈。

sentences.en: A photo fit was even released of this blonde girl alleged to have been seen with Catherine, but she was never identified.
sentences.zh: 警方甚至发布了据称与凯瑟琳一起被看到的这个金发女孩的拼图照片，但她从未被识别出来。

sentences.en: If it was true that Catherine did go to Narry Warren instead of work with an unknown friend, it's possible she may have decided to hitchhike home.
sentences.zh: 如果凯瑟琳确实带着一个不认识的朋友去了纳里沃伦而不是去上班，那么她有可能决定搭便车回家。

sentences.en: Hitchhiking was very common at the time, and another bus driver came forward saying he was positive he had seen Catherine hitchhiking in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 当时搭便车非常普遍，另一名公交车司机站出来说，他确信自己以前见过凯瑟琳搭便车。

sentences.en: Police determined that these sightings of Catherine were unreliable and that there was no evidence Catherine got onto the bus.
sentences.zh: 警方确定这些对凯瑟琳的目击情报不可靠，并且没有证据表明凯瑟琳上了公交车。

sentences.en: Anne-Marie Sargent was 18 years old, a happy-go-lucky girl with a large group of friends.
sentences.zh: 安娜-玛丽·萨金特年仅18岁，是一个无忧无虑的女孩，有着一大群朋友。

sentences.en: She lived with family friends on Railway Road in another outer eastern suburb called Cranbourne.
sentences.zh: 她和家人朋友住在另一处东部外郊克兰本的铁路路上。

sentences.en: Cranbourne, a fairly rural area, is almost right in the centre between Frankston and Berwick, in a north-easterly direction.
sentences.zh: 克兰本是一个相当乡野的地区，几乎正位于弗兰克斯顿和贝里克之间东北方向的中心。

sentences.en: Anne-Marie was unemployed and struggling to find a career.
sentences.zh: 安娜-玛丽失业了，一直在艰难地寻找职业。

sentences.en: On the 6th of October 1980, just over a month after Catherine had gone missing,
sentences.zh: 1980年10月6日，就在凯瑟琳失踪一个多月后，

sentences.en: Anne-Marie visited her mother on Cranbourne Drive.
sentences.zh: 安娜-玛丽在克兰本大道拜访了她的母亲。

sentences.en: When she left, she said she was headed to the nearby suburb of Dandenong, to the Commonwealth Employment Service, or CES, to collect an unemployment check.
sentences.zh: 她离开时说，她要前往附近的丹德农郊区，去联邦就业服务局（即CES）领失业救济金。

sentences.en: It was located about 15 kilometres west of where Catherine Hedland disappeared in Berwick.
sentences.zh: 它位于凯瑟琳·赫德兰在贝里克失踪地点以西约15公里处。

sentences.en: Anne-Marie told her mother that she would be returning later in the day to collect some clothing.
sentences.zh: 安娜-玛丽告诉母亲，她当天晚些时候会回来拿一些衣服。

sentences.en: Anne-Marie made it to the CES office.
sentences.zh: 安娜-玛丽确实到了CES办公室。

sentences.en: She lodged a form there, but after she left the office, she was never seen again.
sentences.zh: 她在那里提交了一份表格，但在离开办公室后，她就再也没有出现过。

sentences.en: Anne-Marie's father, Fred Sargent, said she commonly got around by hitchhiking due to having a lack of money.
sentences.zh: 安娜-玛丽的父亲弗雷德·萨金特说，由于缺钱，她平时出行经常靠搭便车。

sentences.en: He said, she could have had money from home for a bus, but she said she would rather walk, because she loved walking.
sentences.zh: 他说，她本来可以从家里拿钱坐公交车，但她说她宁愿走路，因为她喜欢走路。

sentences.en: On the day she went missing, I knew that she had to hitchhike into Dandenong because she never had money to get the bus.
sentences.zh: 在她失踪的那天，我知道她必须搭便车去丹德农，因为她从来没有钱坐公交车。

sentences.en: My belief is that she was picked up and killed while hitchhiking.
sentences.zh: 我认为她在搭便车时被人接上车并遇害了。

sentences.en: It was revealed that Anne-Marie had an operation a few years earlier to remove fluid from her brain.
sentences.zh: 据透露，安娜-玛丽几年前曾做过一次手术，以切除脑部的积液。

sentences.en: A plastic tube was inserted into the back of her skull during the operation.
sentences.zh: 手术时，她的头骨后部被插入了一根塑料管。

sentences.en: Any knock to her head could have been fatal.
sentences.zh: 头部受到任何撞击都可能是致命的。

sentences.en: Police again came up empty.
sentences.zh: 警方再次一无所获。

sentences.en: No witnesses.
sentences.zh: 没有目击者。

sentences.en: No reports of a struggle or of anything suspicious.
sentences.zh: 没有发生搏斗或任何可疑情况的报告。

sentences.en: No leads.
sentences.zh: 没有线索。

sentences.en: Anne-Marie just vanished.
sentences.zh: 安娜-玛丽就这样凭空消失了。

sentences.en: Nuramul Stevenson was 34 years old.
sentences.zh: 努拉穆尔·史蒂文森34岁。

sentences.en: She was born in Thailand.
sentences.zh: 她出生于泰国。

sentences.en: She married Victorian dairy farmer Wayne Stevenson in Thailand in 1978, before moving to Australia in August 1979, leaving her two children in the care of her parents.
sentences.zh: 1978年，她在泰国嫁给了维多利亚州的奶农韦恩·史蒂文森，随后于1979年8月搬到澳大利亚，将两个孩子交由父母照顾。

sentences.en: She struggled to settle in Australia, and had immediate doubts about her decision to move here.
sentences.zh: 她在澳大利亚很难安定下来，并对搬到这里的决定产生了即时的怀疑。

sentences.en: Wayne and Nuramul lived on a farm in Dean's Marsh,
sentences.zh: 韦恩和努拉穆尔住在迪恩斯马什的一个农场里，

sentences.en: 134 kilometres south-west of Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 位于墨尔本西南134公里处。

sentences.en: On the 28th of November 1980, they visited Melbourne with another couple to see a concert.
sentences.zh: 1980年11月28日，他们和另一对夫妇一起去墨尔本看音乐会。

sentences.en: They stayed overnight with friends near Hartwell Station in Camberwell.
sentences.zh: 他们在坎伯韦尔哈特韦尔车站附近的朋友家过夜。

sentences.en: Hartwell Station sits between Glen Iris and Camberwell, only about three and a half kilometres from where Bertha Miller disappeared on her way to church, ten weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 哈特韦尔车站位于格伦艾瑞斯和坎伯韦尔之间，距离伯莎·米勒十周前在去教堂路上失踪的地方只有大约三公里半。

sentences.en: The next day, the 29th of November, they all visited another friend in Park Street, Brunswick, about 18 kilometres or 11 miles away in the inner north of Melbourne,
sentences.zh: 第二天，即11月29日，他们一行人拜访了位于墨尔本内北区布伦瑞克帕克街的另一位朋友，距离大约18公里或11英里，

sentences.en: and about 45 kilometres north-west of where Anne-Marie Sargent disappeared in Cranbourne.
sentences.zh: 距离安娜-玛丽·萨金特在克兰本失踪的地点西北约45公里。

sentences.en: When they got there, Nuramul refused to get out of the car and go up into the flat.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达那里时，努拉穆尔拒绝下车上公寓。

sentences.en: She was upset about the visit, as she had gone to the market earlier that day to buy ingredients for a tyre meal she planned to cook for everyone.
sentences.zh: 她对这次造访感到心烦意乱，因为她那天早些时候去市场买了一些食材，打算做一顿准备给所有人吃的轮胎大餐。

sentences.en: But instead, they went out drinking.
sentences.zh: 但相反，他们出去喝酒了。

sentences.en: Wayne Stevenson and the other couple went into the flat where they drunk wine and coffee.
sentences.zh: 韦恩·史蒂文森和另一对夫妇走进了公寓，在那里喝了葡萄酒和咖啡。

sentences.en: Wayne came down at least three times to check on Nuramul.
sentences.zh: 韦恩至少三次下楼查看努拉穆尔的情况。

sentences.en: The second time, he found her walking down the street from the direction of a 7-Eleven.
sentences.zh: 第二次，他发现她正从一家7-Eleven的方向沿着街道走来。

sentences.en: The third time, he found her talking tyre to a man in a car.
sentences.zh: 第三次，他发现她正和车里的一个男人谈论轮胎。

sentences.en: The man had a European accent.
sentences.zh: 这个男人有欧洲口音。

sentences.en: After this third check, Wayne sat with his wife in their car until it was nearly dawn.
sentences.zh: 第三次查看后，韦恩一直和妻子坐在车里，直到快天亮。

sentences.en: Then he walked upstairs and fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 然后他走上楼去睡着了。

sentences.en: Nuramul remained in the car, still refusing to enter the flat.
sentences.zh: 努拉穆尔留在车里，依然拒绝进入公寓。

sentences.en: Shortly after 6am, Wayne Stevenson walked back downstairs to see his wife.
sentences.zh: 清晨6点刚过，韦恩·史蒂文森再次走下楼去看望妻子。

sentences.en: But she wasn't there.
sentences.zh: 但她不在那儿。

sentences.en: The car was still there.
sentences.zh: 车还在。

sentences.en: But Nuramul was missing.
sentences.zh: 但努拉穆尔不见了。

sentences.en: Police were called, but got nowhere.
sentences.zh: 警方被叫来，但一无所获。

sentences.en: No witnesses.
sentences.zh: 没有目击者。

sentences.en: No evidence.
sentences.zh: 没有证据。

sentences.en: No signs of a struggle.
sentences.zh: 没有搏斗的迹象。

sentences.en: No leads at all.
sentences.zh: 完全没有线索。

sentences.en: They weren't convinced this was even a missing persons case, given the argument the Stevenson's had had.
sentences.zh: 鉴于史蒂文森夫妇曾发生过争吵，他们甚至不确信这是一起失踪人口案件。

sentences.en: The case quickly went cold.
sentences.zh: 案件很快陷入僵局。

sentences.en: None of the cases were linked at this stage.
sentences.zh: 在这个阶段，这些案件之间没有任何联系。

sentences.en: That wouldn't happen until one week after Nuramul's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 直到努拉穆尔失踪一周后，这种情况才发生改变。

sentences.en: The 6th of December, 1980.
Around 40km, or 24 miles east of Berwick and Cranbourne, local garage owner Graham Brenchley and two friends, Tom Luby and Len Trawin,
sentences.zh: 在贝里克和克兰本以东约40公里或24英里处，当地车库老板格雷厄姆·布伦奇利和两个朋友汤姆·勒比以及伦·特罗文，

sentences.en: had spent the morning slaughtering nine lambs in the shed on Brenchley's property in the town of Garfield.
sentences.zh: 在加菲尔德镇布伦奇利房产的棚子里，花了一上午时间宰杀了九只羔羊。

sentences.en: They needed somewhere to dump the offal.
sentences.zh: 他们需要找个地方倾倒内脏。

sentences.en: Trawin went to the cool room to store the carcasses, while Brenchley and Luby jumped in a car and headed to an area of scrub at Tynong North.
sentences.zh: 特罗文去冷库存放胴体，而布伦奇利和勒比则跳上一辆车，前往蒂农北部的灌木丛地区。

sentences.en: Tynong North is a small rural town located 75km, or 47 miles, southeast of Melbourne, and it has a population of only about 400 people, and is mainly farm and bushland.
sentences.zh: 蒂农北部是一个位于墨尔本东南75公里或47英里处的小农村，人口仅约400人，主要由农场和灌木林组成。

sentences.en: Brenchley knew the foxes and wild dogs in Tynong North would take care of the offal for him.
sentences.zh: 布伦奇利知道蒂农北部的狐狸和野狗会帮他处理掉内脏。

sentences.en: Two kilometres north of the Princess Highway at Tynong North, along Brew Road, there is a dead-end dirt track that leads up to an abandoned sand quarry, now filled with water.
sentences.zh: 在蒂农北部沿着布鲁路从普林斯高速公路向北两公里处，有一条死胡同土路，通向一个废弃的沙石采石场，如今里面蓄满了水。

sentences.en: The track is rarely used.
sentences.zh: 这条小路很少有人使用。

sentences.en: To the left of the dirt road, there were numerous wallaby tracks leading in different directions.
sentences.zh: 土路左侧有许多通往不同方向的小袋鼠足迹。

sentences.en: A quiet, isolated area, thick with flies and infested by snakes.
sentences.zh: 这是一个宁静、偏僻的地区，苍蝇密布，蛇类横行。

sentences.en: The chances of running into another person were remote.
sentences.zh: 遇到另一个人的机率微乎其微。

sentences.en: It was the ideal spot.
sentences.zh: 这是个理想的地点。

sentences.en: It was about 2.30pm.
sentences.zh: 当时大约是下午2点30分。

sentences.en: Brenchley chose a wallaby track and started walking, looking to dump what was left of the lamb.
sentences.zh: 布伦奇利选了一条袋鼠小径开始步行，寻找倾倒羔羊残余物的地方。

sentences.en: As he was walking, he looked to his right and was stunned.
sentences.zh: 走着走着，他向右一看，惊呆了。

sentences.en: He called out to his mate, Luby.
sentences.zh: 他大声叫他的朋友勒比。

sentences.en: Christ, there's a body over here.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这边有一具尸体。

sentences.en: Brenchley went in for a closer look and called out a second time.
sentences.zh: 布伦奇利走近查看，第二次大声喊道。

sentences.en: No, there are two of them.
sentences.zh: 不，有两个。

sentences.en: Brenchley had found the bodies of Bertha Miller and Anne-Marie Sargent hidden in dense, low scrub.
sentences.zh: 布伦奇利发现了伯莎·米勒和安娜-玛丽·萨金特的尸体，她们被藏在浓密低矮的灌木丛中。

sentences.en: Like Alison Rook and Joy Summers, the bodies weren't buried, but the dense undergrowth in which they were found provided sufficient concealment.
sentences.zh: 就像爱丽丝·鲁克和乔伊·萨默斯一样，尸体没有被埋葬，但她们被发现时所在的茂密灌木丛提供了足够的掩护。

sentences.en: The crime scenes of Alison and Joy were about 50 kilometres west of the Tynong North crime scene.
sentences.zh: 爱丽丝和乔伊的犯罪现场在蒂农北部犯罪现场以西约50公里处。

sentences.en: Both bodies were badly decomposed.
sentences.zh: 两具尸体都严重腐烂。

sentences.en: They were laying face-up, head to feet beside each other at the base of a large tree.
sentences.zh: 她们面朝上仰卧，头对脚并排躺在一棵大树的树根旁。

sentences.en: Each had one arm across the chest, and the other beside their body.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有一只手臂横在胸前，另一只手臂放在身体旁。

sentences.en: Anne-Marie Sargent was naked, but Bertha Miller was still heavily clothed.
sentences.zh: 安娜-玛丽·萨金特一丝不挂，但伯莎·米勒仍然穿着厚重的衣服。

sentences.en: Police were called and a crime scene was established.
sentences.zh: 警方被叫来，并建立了一个犯罪现场。

sentences.en: A thorough search of the area the following morning on Sunday the 7th of December located a third body at 10am, only about 15 metres away.
sentences.zh: 第二天（12月7日星期日）上午，对该地区进行的彻底搜查于上午10点在仅仅约15米外发现了第三具尸体。

sentences.en: It was Catherine Hedlund.
sentences.zh: 那是凯瑟琳·赫德兰。

sentences.en: A member of the Forensic Science Laboratory found her.
sentences.zh: 法医实验室的一名成员找到了她。

sentences.en: She was also badly decomposed and had been left naked.
sentences.zh: 她也严重腐烂，并且赤身裸体。

sentences.en: The media immediately printed headlines drawing comparisons to the infamous Truro murders in South Australia.
sentences.zh: 媒体立即刊登了头条新闻，将其与南澳大利亚州臭名昭著的特鲁罗谋杀案进行比较。

sentences.en: Seven women were killed between December 76 and February 77.
sentences.zh: 1976年12月至1977年2月期间，有七名女性被杀。

sentences.en: Five of the victims were dumped in bush paddocks at Truro, just off a main highway.
sentences.zh: 其中五名受害者被抛弃在特鲁罗靠近主公路的灌木围场里。

sentences.en: When asked about the similarities, the head of the Victorian Homicide Squad,
sentences.zh: 当被问及相似之处时，维多利亚州凶杀案调查科负责人、

sentences.en: Chief Inspector Paul Delianis, shot it down, saying, this is just a local problem.
sentences.zh: 总督察保罗·代利亚尼斯予以否认，称这只是一个地方性问题。

sentences.en: He continued, it seems this is the dumping ground for some sort of killer.
sentences.zh: 他接着说，这似乎是某种杀手的抛尸地。

sentences.en: We are not overlooking the possibility that there are others there.
sentences.zh: 我们没有忽视那里还有其他人的可能性。

sentences.en: He said the search and rescue squad would closely comb over the 10 hectare,
sentences.zh: 他说，搜救队将仔细搜查这片10公顷、

sentences.en: 24 acre area for clues, and for more bodies.
sentences.zh: 24英亩的区域以寻找线索和更多尸体。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案案卷稍后将回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持档案案卷继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Postmortems were conducted on Monday the 8th of December.
sentences.zh: 尸检于12月8日星期一进行。

sentences.en: Emery Sargent was able to be identified by the plastic tube inserted in her skull during her brain operation.
sentences.zh: 埃米莉·萨金特是通过她在脑部手术期间插入头骨的塑料管被识别出来的。

sentences.en: It took a few days to identify Bertha Miller and Catherine Hedlund.
sentences.zh: 花了几天时间才辨认出伯莎·米勒和凯瑟琳·赫德兰。

sentences.en: Bertha was identified by the dress she was wearing and a hair match to a brush found in her home.
sentences.zh: 伯莎是通过她穿的裙子以及与在她家中找到的一把刷子上的头发匹配来辨认的。

sentences.en: Catherine was identified by a leather anklet, earrings and dental records.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳是通过皮质脚踝饰品、耳环和牙科记录被辨认出来的。

sentences.en: Police were surprised to learn of the age gap between the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 警方惊讶地发现受害者之间的年龄差距很大。

sentences.en: Chief Inspector Paul Delianis said police initially thought it likely that all the victims would be young.
sentences.zh: 总督察保罗·代利亚尼斯表示，警方最初认为所有受害者很可能都很年轻。

sentences.en: We were looking at a possible sexual motive, but we will have to look again at the situation.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在考虑可能的性动机，但我们必须重新审视这种情况。

sentences.en: The sexual motive wasn't completely discarded, but it didn't fit any known pattern given the substantial age gap of the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 性动机并没有被完全排除，但鉴于受害者之间存在巨大的年龄差距，它不符合任何已知的模式。

sentences.en: Due to the bad state of decomposition, no cause of death was able to be determined for any of the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 由于尸体腐烂严重，无法确定任何受害者的死因。

sentences.en: Police confirmed they were checking for similarities between the three Tainong victims and the murder of Alison Rook in Frankston.
sentences.zh: 警方证实，他们正在调查这三名泰农受害者与弗兰克斯顿爱丽丝·鲁克谋杀案之间的相似之处。

sentences.en: Joyce Summers, the second Frankston victim, hadn't been attacked at this point in time.
sentences.zh: 乔伊斯·萨默斯是第二位弗兰克斯顿受害者，当时尚未遭到袭击。

sentences.en: Each victim was either waiting for public transport or was hitchhiking.
sentences.zh: 每位受害者要么在等公共交通，要么在搭便车。

sentences.en: Each victim was close to home and disappeared from public areas shortly after being seen by witnesses.
sentences.zh: 每位受害者都离家不远，在被目击者看到后不久便从公共场所失踪。

sentences.en: Yet there were no witnesses to any suspicious activity.
sentences.zh: 然而，没有任何可疑活动的目击证人。

sentences.en: No tips had been called in.
sentences.zh: 没有接到任何举报电话。

sentences.en: A special operations room was set up at Russell Street Police Headquarters in central Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 墨尔本市中心罗素街警察总部设立了一个特别行动室。

sentences.en: Over 25 police were involved in the search and initial investigation.
sentences.zh: 超过25名警察参与了搜查和初步调查。

sentences.en: An early avenue of investigation was to set up a roadblock near the Glen Iris home of Bertha Miller.
sentences.zh: 早期的一个调查方向是在伯莎·米勒位于格伦艾瑞斯的家附近设立路障。

sentences.en: The roadblock occurred on Sunday the 14th of December on High Street, Glen Iris.
sentences.zh: 路障设置于12月14日星期日在格伦艾瑞斯的高街上。

sentences.en: Although it had been four months since the day she disappeared, police hoped someone would come forward with information.
sentences.zh: 尽管距离她失踪已经过去四个月，警方仍希望有人能提供信息。

sentences.en: Maybe someone remembered something.
sentences.zh: 也许有人还记得什么。

sentences.en: And they did.
sentences.zh: 他们确实记起来了。

sentences.en: Police learnt that Bertha may have accepted rides from strangers in the past, despite her brother-in-law saying she wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 警方了解到，尽管伯莎的连襟说她不会，但她过去可能接受过陌生人的搭乘。

sentences.en: Detective Inspector Ritchie from the Homicide Squad said, It appears she was the sort of person who would accept a lift from people she did not know.
sentences.zh: 凶杀案调查组的里奇侦探督察表示：“看来她是那种会接受不认识的人顺风车的人。”

sentences.en: We have spoken to a number of people who have given her lifts at various times in the paSt.
sentences.zh: “我们已经和许多在不同时间让她搭过便车的人谈过。”

sentences.en: After successfully learning this information from the roadblock set up for Bertha, police set up a roadblock the next day on Thomas Street, Dandenong,
sentences.zh: 在成功从为伯莎设置的路障中获取这些信息后，警方第二天在丹德农的托马斯街设置了路障，

sentences.en: seeking information about Anne-Marie Sargent.
sentences.zh: 寻找关于安娜-玛丽·萨金特的信息。

sentences.en: It was there in Dandenong that Anne-Marie was last seen collecting her unemployment check.
sentences.zh: 正是在丹德农，安娜-玛丽最后一次被看到在领取她的失业救济金。

sentences.en: Following the information that had been received about the possible sighting of Catherine Hedland in Nary Warren on the afternoon of her disappearance,
sentences.zh: 根据收到的关于凯瑟琳·赫德兰失踪当天下午在纳里沃伦疑似目击的信息，

sentences.en: a dummy wearing the same clothes as Catherine was displayed in the area on Friday the 19th of December.
sentences.zh: 12月19日星期五，当地展示了一个穿着与凯瑟琳相同衣服的假人。

sentences.en: After the early steps of the investigation had taken place, police issued a press release stating that the driver of a white taxi may be able to assist with their inquiries.
sentences.zh: 在调查的早期步骤完成后，警方发布了一份新闻稿，称一辆白色出租车的司机或许能够协助他们的调查。

sentences.en: Witnesses had come forward and said that a white taxi, possibly a Holden Kingswood, was spotted near where the bodies were found on three occasions
sentences.zh: 目击者挺身而出称，在发现尸体的地点附近曾三次看到一辆白色出租车，可能是一辆霍顿金斯伍德，

sentences.en: that corresponded with the time of the killings.
sentences.zh: 这与行凶时间相吻合。

sentences.en: Paul Delianis said no connection had been made between the three victims, so they believed the taxi could have been used as a ploy to pick them up.
sentences.zh: 保罗·代利亚尼斯表示，这三名受害者之间没有建立联系，因此他们认为这辆出租车可能被用作将她们接走的幌子。

sentences.en: After making extensive inquiries with taxi companies, police were told that some drivers offered free lifts to women and this was known to happen in the Tainong North area,
sentences.zh: 在对出租车公司进行广泛查询后，警方被告知一些司机曾向女性提供免费搭车，已知这种事在泰农北部地区发生过，

sentences.en: but they weren't able to identify the taxi they were looking for or the driver.
sentences.zh: 但他们未能确认他们正在寻找的出租车或司机。

sentences.en: On Thursday the 3rd of February 1983, two years into two months after the original discovery at Tainong North, a teacher and former AFL footballer
sentences.zh: 1983年2月3日星期四，即蒂农北部最初发现尸体两年零两个月后，一名教师兼前澳式足球运动员

sentences.en: Barry Davis found the body of Nuremoor Stevenson.
sentences.zh: 巴里·戴维斯发现了努尔穆尔·史蒂文森的尸体。

sentences.en: Barry was driving along the Princess Highway in Tainong North when a tyre went flat on a trailer he was towing.
sentences.zh: 巴里正开车沿着蒂农北部的普林斯高速公路行驶，这时他拖着的一辆拖车的一个轮胎爆了。

sentences.en: They pulled over opposite a truck stop.
sentences.zh: 他们把车停在卡车休息站对面。

sentences.en: While his mate went to try and borrow a jack,
sentences.zh: 当他的同伴去设法借千斤顶时，

sentences.en: Barry decided to stretch his legs.
sentences.zh: 巴里决定舒展一下双腿。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: “引述：

sentences.en: I decided to take a walk up the bush track.
sentences.zh: 我决定沿着灌木小径走走。

sentences.en: I walked up this track for approximately 50 metres from the road and came to a dead end.
sentences.zh: 我沿着这条小径从路边走了大约50米，来到了一条死胡同。

sentences.en: I then turned around to walk back and noticed a bone on the ground.
sentences.zh: 然后我转身往回走，注意到地上有一块骨头。”

sentences.en: At the time,
sentences.zh: 当时，

sentences.en: Barry was a senior lecturer in anatomy and physiology and immediately recognised it as a human thigh bone.
sentences.zh: 巴里是解剖学和生理学的高级讲师，并立即认出这是一根人类大腿骨。

sentences.en: The track he is referring to is the same one off Brew Road that led to the old sand quarry where Bertha,
sentences.zh: 他所指的那条小路与通往旧沙石场的布鲁路（Brew Road）是同一条，伯莎、

sentences.en: Catherine and Anne-Marie were found.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳和安娜-玛丽就是在那里被发现的。

sentences.en: Police were notified, attended the scene and after a search they located the body of Nuremoor Stevenson.
sentences.zh: 警方接到报警后赶到现场，经过搜查，找到了努尔穆尔·史蒂文森的尸体。

sentences.en: Like the others, she wasn't buried but concealed by thick undergrowth.
sentences.zh: 和其他人一样，她没有被埋葬，而是被茂密的灌木丛掩盖着。

sentences.en: She was found naked on the opposite side of the track to the other victims, closer to the highway, about two kilometres away from the first crime scene.
sentences.zh: 人们在与其他受害者相反的那一侧小路上发现了她，她赤身裸体，靠近高速公路，距离第一案发现场大约两公里。

sentences.en: Detective Chief Superintendent
sentences.zh: 侦探总警司

sentences.en: Phil Bennett said,
sentences.zh: 菲尔·贝内特说：

sentences.en: We have every reason to believe the fourth body is connected to the other three.
sentences.zh: 我们有充分的理由相信第四具尸体与前三具有关。

sentences.en: They were too close not to be connected.
sentences.zh: 它们靠得太近了，不可能没有关联。

sentences.en: Like the other victims, an autopsy failed to identify a cause of death.
sentences.zh: 与其他受害者一样，尸检未能确定死因。

sentences.en: Nuremoor was identified by dental records.
sentences.zh: 努尔穆尔是通过牙科记录辨认出来的。

sentences.en: After two and a half years of investigation and more than 1,000 interviews, they had found the fourth body at Tynal.
sentences.zh: 经过两年半的调查和1,000多次走访，他们在蒂纳尔（Tynal）找到了第四具尸体。

sentences.en: They had answered the question lingering over whether Nuremoor Stevenson had met with foul play.
sentences.zh: 他们回答了萦绕在人们心头的问题：努尔穆尔·史蒂文森是否遭遇了不测。

sentences.en: So the timeline is,
sentences.zh: 所以时间线是这样的：

sentences.en: Alison Rook was the first to go missing on the 30th of May, 1980.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森·鲁克是第一个失踪的人，时间是1980年5月30日。

sentences.en: She was found five weeks later at Frankston.
sentences.zh: 五周后，她在弗兰克斯顿（Frankston）被发现。

sentences.en: Bertha Miller was the next to disappear on the 10th of August, 1980.
sentences.zh: 伯莎·米勒是下一个失踪的人，时间是1980年8月10日。

sentences.en: Then Catherine Hedlund on the 18th of August, 1980.
sentences.zh: 然后是1980年8月18日的凯瑟琳·赫德lund。

sentences.en: Then Anne-Marie Sargent on the 6th of August, 1980.
sentences.zh: 接着是1980年8月6日的安娜-玛丽·萨金特。

sentences.en: Nuremoor Stevenson on the 30th of November, 1980.
sentences.zh: 努尔穆尔·史蒂文森失踪于1980年11月30日。

sentences.en: Proximity-wise,
sentences.zh: 就距离而言，

sentences.en: Nuremoor was by far the furthest distance to the other women when she disappeared.
sentences.zh: 努尔穆尔失踪时距离其他女性是迄今为止最远的。

sentences.en: But the night before she went missing, she had stayed the night in the next suburb from where Bertha Miller had disappeared from.
sentences.zh: 但在她失踪的前一晚，她在伯莎·米勒失踪地点的下一个郊区过夜。

sentences.en: The bodies of Bertha,
sentences.zh: 伯莎、

sentences.en: Catherine, and Anne-Marie were found at Tynal North on the 6th of December, 1980.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳和安娜-玛丽的尸体于1980年12月6日在蒂纳尔以北（Tynal North）被发现。

sentences.en: Joyce Summers went missing on the 9th of October, 1981, and was found at Frankston six weeks later.
sentences.zh: 乔伊斯·萨默斯于1981年10月9日失踪，六周后在弗兰克斯顿被发现。

sentences.en: Nuremoor Stevenson was the last to be found on the 3rd of February, 1983, at Tynal North.
sentences.zh: 努尔穆尔·史蒂文森是最后一个被发现的人，于1983年2月3日在蒂纳尔以北被发现。

sentences.en: Police were treating the Tynal North investigation separate to the Frankston investigation, but were open to the idea that they could be linked.
sentences.zh: 警方将蒂纳尔以北的调查与弗兰克斯顿的调查分开处理，但也对它们可能有关联的想法持开放态度。

sentences.en: In fact, opinions were divided amongst the investigators as to whether or not they were hunting one or two killers.
sentences.zh: 事实上，调查人员对他们是在追捕一个还是两个凶手存在分歧。

sentences.en: Some even suggested it could be three.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至暗示可能是三个。

sentences.en: A coronial inquest into the four Tynal North murders was held at Hawthorne Coroner's Court in Melbourne before Coroner Anthony Ellis.
sentences.zh: 关于这四起蒂纳尔以北谋杀案的验尸官调查在墨尔本的霍桑验尸法庭（Hawthorne Coroner's Court）举行，由验尸官安东尼·埃利斯主持。

sentences.en: Ellis released his findings on Wednesday, the 12th of June, 1985.
sentences.zh: 埃利斯于1985年6月12日星期三公布了他的调查结果。

sentences.en: By now, the investigation had been ongoing for four and a half years.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，调查已经进行了四年半。

sentences.en: 2,000 interviews had been conducted, which had taken detectives as far as North Queensland.
sentences.zh: 已经进行了2,000次走访，侦探们的足迹甚至远至昆士兰州北部。

sentences.en: There were 11,400 pages of notes, statements, and other documents.
sentences.zh: 有11,400页的笔记、陈述和其他文件。

sentences.en: Some suspects had been identified, but there was insufficient evidence for any arrests.
sentences.zh: 已经确定了一些嫌疑人，但没有足够的证据进行任何逮捕。

sentences.en: Coroner Ellis said that the person or persons responsible for the murders appeared to have no criteria in the selection of victiMs.
sentences.zh: 验尸官埃利斯表示，对谋杀案负责的个人或团伙在选择受害者时似乎没有任何标准。

sentences.en: There were great disparities in the ages and social backgrounds of the four women, but there were similarities that linked them all.
sentences.zh: 这四名女性的年龄和社会背景存在巨大差异，但也有将她们联系在一起的相似之处。

sentences.en: All disappeared on large roads while using public transport or hitchhiking.
sentences.zh: 所有人都是在大路上使用公共交通工具或搭便车时失踪的。

sentences.en: All four were either unemployed or worked only part-time and therefore had free time during the day.
sentences.zh: 这四人要么失业，要么只做兼职工作，因此白天有空闲时间。

sentences.en: After all of the evidence was heard before the coroner's court, coroner Anthony Ellis was unable to determine how, when, or where the women died.
sentences.zh: 在验尸法庭听取了所有证据后，验尸官安东尼·埃利斯无法确定这些女性是如何、何时或在哪里死亡的。

sentences.en: It was an open finding.
sentences.zh: 这是一个未决裁决。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述：

sentences.en: There does not appear to be any particular pattern to the date or times that the women disappeared.
sentences.zh: 女性失踪的日期或时间似乎没有任何特定的规律。

sentences.en: There is no doubt that foul play must be suspected.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，必须怀疑存在谋杀。

sentences.en: I must return an open verdict.
sentences.zh: 我必须做出开放式裁决。

sentences.en: A $50,000 reward was in place for information leading to an arrest for each victim at both Tainong North and Frankston.
sentences.zh: 泰农以北（Tainong North）和弗兰克斯顿两起案件中，每提供一条导致逮捕受害者的线索，就会悬赏50,000美元。

sentences.en: The reward is still in place today and has never been increased.
sentences.zh: 这笔悬赏金至今仍然有效，从未增加。

sentences.en: This case didn't attract the media coverage that other cases have.
sentences.zh: 这个案子没有像其他案子那样吸引媒体的报道。

sentences.en: Compare it to two other
sentences.zh: 把它与其他两个

sentences.en: Victorian cases, the Frankston serial killer
sentences.zh: 维多利亚州的案件进行比较，弗兰克斯顿连环杀手

sentences.en: Paul Denyer, which was still a decade away, or Mr. Cruel, which was also a few years away from breaking.
sentences.zh: 保罗·丹耶尔（Paul Denyer）还要十年才会出现，或者“残酷先生”（Mr. Cruel）距离破案也还有几年时间。

sentences.en: And the media coverage of Tainong North and Frankston was far lower in comparison.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，泰农以北和弗兰克斯顿的媒体报道要少得多。

sentences.en: Despite this, the police had still conducted an extremely large scale and intense investigation, one of the largest in Victoria's history up to that point.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，警方还是进行了规模极其庞大且密集的调查，这是维多利亚州历史上最大的调查之一。

sentences.en: They believed sexual assault was a motivation for the killings, but couldn't prove it.
sentences.zh: 他们认为性侵犯是杀戮的动机，但无法证明。

sentences.en: They also believed the victims were asphyxiated or stabbed, but again, they couldn't prove it.
sentences.zh: 他们还认为受害者是被窒息或刺死的，但同样，他们无法证明。

sentences.en: The investigation continued, however, with no fresh leads and not enough evidence to make any arrests.
sentences.zh: 然而，调查仍在继续，但没有新的线索，也没有足够的证据进行逮捕。

sentences.en: It was eventually scaled back.
